supportTickets.subject: Understanding Simulated Charges
supportTickets.description: How are STT and exchange turnover fees calculated on intraday vs delivery trades?
supportTickets.response: Delivery trades incur 0.1% STT on both buy/sell sides with 0% brokerage. Intraday trades incur 0.03% (max ₹20) brokerage and 0.025% STT on sell side only.
